result.title: Senior AI Software Engineer
result.fit_rationale: Adjacent rather than direct fit. The candidate has strong Python and historical C++ experience, deep performance engineering and debugging skills, and practical AI/LLM project evidence including agentic pipelines, retrieval, LLM scoring, and MCP. The part-time remote structure aligns with their stated consulting target. However, the core role—building RL environments and reproducible software engineering benchmarks using Docker, GDB, ASan, FFmpeg, and similar tooling—is not evidenced in the profile. Current work is more infrastructure/capacity focused than production software development or large-scale codebase refactoring.
strengths: Expert-level Python and strong ETL/automation background
Historical C++ optimization experience from large-scale data migration work
Deep performance engineering, bottleneck analysis, and debugging experience
Practical AI/LLM project evidence: agentic pipelines, retrieval, LLM scoring, MCP
Part-time remote availability aligns well with the engagement model
gaps: No evidence of reinforcement learning environment design or AI training/evaluation benchmark development
No listed experience with Docker, GDB, AddressSanitizer, FFmpeg, or similar environment tooling
No direct DevOps/CI/CD or containerization experience in the profile
Software refactoring and feature development evidence is largely historical or project-level, not current production software engineering
tailoring_plan: Lead with Python/C++ performance optimization and debugging evidence, map the agentic job-search/LLM scoring pipeline to AI evaluation experience, explicitly acknowledge the RL/tooling gap, and propose a small sample engineering benchmark or a focused ramp on Docker/GDB/ASan to reduce risk.
